# TYPO3 coder

## Introduction

This package adds multiple tools for TYPO3 coding:

- rector: for code refactoring and deprecations
- fractor: for code refactoring (XML, Yaml, Fluid, TypoScript and so on)
- php-cs-fixer: for code style
- phplint: for code linting
- phpunit: for unit testing

## Installation

`composer require --dev gaya/typo3-coder`

Configure .gitignore:

```
# Ignore files generated by gaya/typo3-coder
/.phplint.yml
/.php-cs-fixer.php
/fractor.php
/rector.php
/build/phpunit/PhpUnit.xml

# Builders cache
/.phplint.cache
/.php-cs-fixer.cache
/.phpunit.result.cache
/.phpunit.cache
```

## Customization

### php-cs-fixer

You can customize the php-cs-fixer configuration by adding .php-cs-fixer.project.php

Example:

```
<?php

$rules = $config->getRules();
$rules['declare_strict_types'] = false;
$config->setRules($rules);
```

### rector

You can customize the rector configuration by adding .rector.php

Example:

```
<?php

$rectorConfigBuilder->withSkip([\Rector\CodeQuality\Rector\ClassMethod\OptionalParametersAfterRequiredRector::class]);
```

> #### Note
> rectorConfigBuilder merge the current configuration with new rules.
> So if you want to remove a rule, you will have create a new $rectorConfigBuilder based on the current one.

## Composer commands

Run `composer list coder` for more details.

```
Available commands for the "coder" namespace:
  coder:fractor       Run fractor
  coder:php-cs-fixer  Run php-cs-fixer
  coder:phplint       Run phplint
  coder:rector        Run rector
  coder:tests:unit    Run phpunit tests
```

For CI, you can use the --continuous-integration option:

`composer coder:rector --continuous-integration`
